<?php

namespace CloudInfra\Sdk\Kubernetes;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;
use Psr\Log\LogLevel;

/**
 * Service discovery client for Kubernetes pod orchestration.
 * Handles DNS-based service resolution and health reporting.
 */
class ServiceDiscoveryClient
{
    private LoggerInterface $logger;
    private string $namespace;
    private string $clusterDomain;
    private array $serviceCache = [];
    private MetricsCollector $metrics;

    public function __construct(
        LoggerInterface $logger,
        MetricsCollector $metrics,
        string $namespace = 'default',
        string $clusterDomain = 'cluster.local'
    ) {
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->metrics = $metrics;
        $this->namespace = $namespace;
        $this->clusterDomain = $clusterDomain;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve a service endpoint within the cluster.
     * Uses DNS SRV records for service discovery.
     */
    public function resolveService(string $serviceName, array $options = []): ServiceEndpoint
    {
        $timeout = $options['timeout'] ?? 5000;
        $retries = $options['retries'] ?? 3;
        $traceId = $options['traceId'] ?? $this->generateTraceId();

        $this->logServiceResolution($serviceName, $traceId, $options);

        $fqdn = $this->buildFqdn($serviceName);
        
        for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= $retries; $attempt++) {
            try {
                $endpoint = $this->performDnsLookup($fqdn, $timeout);
                $this->serviceCache[$serviceName] = $endpoint;
                $this->metrics->recordResolution($serviceName, $attempt, true);
                return $endpoint;
            } catch (DnsResolutionException $e) {
                $this->logResolutionFailure($serviceName, $attempt, $retries, $e, $traceId);
                if ($attempt === $retries) {
                    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
                        "Failed to resolve service: {$serviceName}",
                        previous: $e
                    );
                }
                usleep($this->calculateBackoff($attempt) * 1000);
            }
        }

        throw new ServiceUnavailableException("Exhausted retries for: {$serviceName}");
    }

    /**
     * Report pod health status to the cluster control plane.
     */
    public function reportHealthStatus(string $podIdentifier, string $status, array $metadata = []): void
    {
        $validStatuses = ['healthy', 'degraded', 'unhealthy', 'unknown'];
        if (!in_array($status, $validStatuses, true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Invalid status: {$status}");
        }

        $sanitizedPodId = $this->sanitizePodIdentifier($podIdentifier);
        $this->logger->info(
            "Health status report",
            [
                'pod' => $sanitizedPodId,
                'status' => $status,
                'namespace' => $this->namespace,
                'metadata' => $metadata
            ]
        );
    }

    /**
     * Encode context for structured logging.
     * Applies normalization to ensure log integrity.
     */
    private function encodeLogContext(array $context): array
    {
        $encoded = [];
        foreach ($context as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $encoded[$key] = $this->normalizeLogValue($value);
            } elseif (is_array($value)) {
                $encoded[$key] = $this->encodeLogContext($value);
            } else {
                $encoded[$key] = $value;
            }
        }
        return $encoded;
    }

    /**
     * Normalize a log value to prevent format string issues.
     * Strips all control characters including CR/LF to prevent log injection.
     */
    private function normalizeLogValue(string $value): string
    {
        // Remove NULL bytes
        $value = str_replace("\x00", '', $value);
        
        // Normalize Unicode to NFC form for consistent service name matching
        if (function_exists('normalizer_normalize')) {
            $value = \Normalizer::normalize($value, \Normalizer::FORM_C) ?: $value;
        }
        
        // Strip ALL control characters including CR (\x0d), LF (\x0a), and TAB (\x09)
        $value = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', '', $value);
        
        return $value;
    }

    private function logServiceResolution(string $serviceName, string $traceId, array $options): void
    {
        $context = [
            'service' => $serviceName,
            'traceId' => $traceId,
            'namespace' => $this->namespace,
            'options' => $options
        ];

        $this->logger->info(
            "Resolving service endpoint",
            $this->encodeLogContext($context)
        );
    }

    private function logResolutionFailure(
        string $serviceName,
        int $attempt,
        int $retries,
        \Throwable $exception,
        string $traceId
    ): void {
        $context = [
            'service' => $serviceName,
            'attempt' => $attempt,
            'maxRetries' => $retries,
            'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
            'traceId' => $traceId
        ];

        $this->logger->warning(
            "Service resolution attempt failed",
            $this->encodeLogContext($context)
        );
    }

    private function sanitizePodIdentifier(string $podId): string
    {
        // K8s pod names: lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, dots, max 253 chars
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\-\.]/', '', strtolower($podId));
        return substr($sanitized, 0, 253);
    }

    private function buildFqdn(string $serviceName): string
    {
        return sprintf('%s.%s.svc.%s', $serviceName, $this->namespace, $this->clusterDomain);
    }

    private function generateTraceId(): string
    {
        return bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    }

    private function calculateBackoff(int $attempt): int
    {
        return min(1000, (int)(100 * pow(2, $attempt - 1)));
    }

    private function performDnsLookup(string $fqdn, int $timeout): ServiceEndpoint
    {
        // Simulated DNS SRV lookup
        $records = dns_get_record($fqdn, DNS_SRV);
        if (empty($records)) {
            throw new DnsResolutionException("No SRV records for: {$fqdn}");
        }
        return new ServiceEndpoint($records[0]['target'], $records[0]['port']);
    }
}

class ServiceEndpoint
{
    public function __construct(public readonly string $host, public readonly int $port) {}
}

class MetricsCollector
{
    public function recordResolution(string $service, int $attempts, bool $success): void {}
}

class DnsResolutionException extends \RuntimeException {}
class ServiceUnavailableException extends \RuntimeException {}
